component.name: rttx
component.summary: A tiling terminal emulator for GNOME

description.p: rttx is a tiling terminal emulator built with GTK4 and Libadwaita, organized around named workspaces and split panes. It features daemon-backed persistent sessions, workspace recovery, input synchronization, reusable command snippets, and drag-and-drop layout rearrangement.

screenshot.caption: rttx with split panes and workspace sidebar

description.p: This release adds disconnect visualization for persistent panes, remote daemon lifecycle management, and force retry for stuck connections.
